infobox.usage: Unlocks apartment 1 on the second floor of the Cardinal apartment complex on Streets of Tarkov.

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: TerraGroup corporate apartment key (TG apt.) is a Key in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: A key found in A.P.'s room. It likely opens one of TerraGroup’s corporate apartments.

sections.heading: Quests
sections.text: - This is a required location for the story chapter The Unheard

sections.heading: Key Location
sections.text:
- In Jackets
- In Drawers
- Pockets and bags of Scavs

sections.heading: Shoreline
sections.text: On a nightstand in east wing room 305 at the health resort. A single key is guaranteed to spawn every raid.

sections.heading: Lock Location
sections.text: Door to apartment 1 on the second floor of the Cardinal apartment complex at Streets of Tarkov.

sections.heading: Behind the Lock
sections.text:
- 1x Plastic suitcase
- Reprogrammed keycard for A.P.'s apartment lock (Green) lock location
